subject: Nimbus Analytics — procurement path & SOC 2 checklist
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@nimbus.io>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@nimbus.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus follow-up — procurement path & SOC 2 checklist

Hi Emma / Ravi — great to meet today, and thanks for the demo time. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum on pricing and procurement alignment.

TL;DR: two procurement tracks look possible — Marketplace (card) or Paperflow (PO + DPA). Key blocker from your side is SOC 2 evidence + DPA negotiation.

Notes from our call:
- Use case: batch inference for customer analytics (high throughput, medium latency tolerance).
- Expected q4 usage: ~750k tokens/day initially; spikes expected on month-end runs.
- Security ask: SOC 2 Type II summary + standard DPA; legal will need a short turnaround.
- Procurement preference: Emma said they "prefer marketplace for speed but may need PO for budgeting".

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a short SOC 2 summary and our DPA draft for your legal to scan (SOC2-summary.pdf, DPA-draft-Redwood-v1.docx).
2) Please confirm if Nimbus would accept marketplace billing (card) for initial POC — if yes, we can start within days. If PO, what internal lead time do you need and who is the contact in procurement?
3) If you have a security questionnaire, please send it over — Monica (cc'd) will lead the answers and can prioritize items that block procurement.
4) I'll schedule a 30-minute sync with your procurement/legal and our contracts/finance if you'd like.

If helpful, Ben can run through marketplace cost implications vs reserved pricing (short 10–15m).

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf), DPA-draft-Redwood-v1.docx (docx)

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@nimbus.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@nimbus.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus follow-up — procurement path & SOC 2 checklist

Thanks Alex — appreciated the clear recap. Quick answers:

- Marketplace for POC would be ideal (speed). We can start on card while procurement confirms PO timeline.
- Procurement lead time for PO: typically 4–6 weeks once SOW and pricing are finalized. Ravi will own the PO process.
- We do have a security questionnaire (standard vendor assessment). I attached the specific checklist to this reply. Main blockers historically: encryption-at-rest details, data retention policies, and audit log retention windows.

Can your security team confirm: what retention window do you offer for audit logs? Also, do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)?

If you can get SOC 2 summary + DPA early this week, I can circulate to legal and procurement. If marketplace is straightforward cost-wise, we can kick-off a short POC on a card.

Thanks,
Emma
Head of Platform Ops, Nimbus Analytics
emma.liu@nimbus.io | +1 206-555-0124

-----Attached: Nimbus-Security-Questionnaire-2027.pdf-----

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@nimbus.io>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@nimbus.io>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus follow-up — procurement path & SOC 2 checklist

Hi Emma / Ravi — Monica from Redwood Security here. Thanks for sending the questionnaire. I've reviewed the main asks and here are short answers / next actions below.

Quick answers to your two explicit questions:
- Audit log retention: default 90 days in the hosted product; for Dedicated / Private we support configurable retention up to 365 days. We can document the retention windows in the DPA or LOE.
- Customer-managed keys: yes, our Private and Dedicated options support KMS integration (AWS KMS / GCP KMS). For hosted Marketplace we offer encryption at rest with provider-managed keys by default; we can discuss a contract addendum if you need CMK for the POC.

Outstanding questionnaire items that need follow-up:
- Specific encryption algorithms used for keys and TLS cipher suites (I will add a short tech appendix).
- Incident response SLA and runbook excerpts (we can share redacted PCI/SOC examples).
- Clarification on data residency (which region will your POC run in?).

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll upload a 2-page tech appendix and SOC 2 executive summary to the Drive folder referenced in Alex's email by EOD today.
2) Alex / Ben — if Nimbus goes marketplace for the POC, Ben can provide the cost delta and expected monthly spend for the usage band they mentioned.
3) If Nimbus opts for PO, Marissa I think we should get the DPA negotiation window and typical contract turnaround on record — can you lead procurement coordination?

Emma — if you can confirm region and whether you'll use marketplace card for initial billing, I can prioritize the more sensitive questionnaire items.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: (will upload SOC appendix and sample IR runbook excerpt to Drive)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@nimbus.io>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@nimbus.io>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus follow-up — procurement path & SOC 2 checklist

Hi all — looping in Redwood commercial ops. Short logistics itemization so Nimbus can choose the smoothest path:

Option A — Marketplace (fastest)
- Billing: card on file, immediate onboarding once POC account created.
- Contract: standard T&Cs via marketplace; no custom DPA negotiation (we provide a standard DPA attachment).
- Good when: short POC timeline, limited internal procurement constraints.

Option B — Paperflow (PO + negotiated DPA)
- Billing: purchase order to Redwood Finance, monthly invoicing per PO terms.
- Contract: Redwood DPA + SOW; typical negotiation window 1–3 weeks for standard edits, up to 4–6 weeks for more substantive legal redlines.
- Good when: needs PO for budget/approval or corporate policy requires it.

To set expectations: for the PO route we typically need: final SOW/pricing, primary procurement contact, and a signed DPA. If Nimbus prefers PO, please share Ravi's procurement contact details and any internal PO templates.

Ben — can you prepare a short comparison (two-slide or single sheet) that shows estimated monthly cost of Marketplace card vs an introductory reserved rate for the expected usage band? Emma / Ravi — if you want Marketplace for POC, we'll provision a trial account once payment method is set up.

Emma — thanks for highlighting the encryption/retention questions; Monica will follow up with the appendix.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0172
